 def chunk_items(items: list, size: int) -> list[list]:
-    raise NotImplementedError
\ No newline at end of file
+    if not isinstance(items, list):
+        raise TypeError("items must be a list")
+    if not isinstance(size, int) or isinstance(size, bool):
+        raise TypeError("size must be an int")
+    if size <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("size must be positive")
+    return [items[i : i + size] for i in range(0, len(items), size)]
diff --git a/utility_pack/normalize_email.py b/utility_pack/normalize_email.py

--- a/utility_pack/normalize_email.py
+++ b/utility_pack/normalize_email.py
@@ -1,2 +1,12 @@
 def normalize_email(value: str) -> str:
-    raise NotImplementedError
\ No newline at end of file
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        raise TypeError("email must be a string")
+    stripped = value.strip()
+    if " " in stripped or "\t" in stripped:
+        raise ValueError("email must not contain whitespace")
+    local, sep, domain = stripped.partition("@")
+    if not sep or "@" in domain:
+        raise ValueError("email must contain exactly one '@'")
+    if not local or not domain:
+        raise ValueError("email must have non-empty local part and domain")
+    return local.lower() + "@" + domain.lower()
diff --git a/utility_pack/parse_size.py b/utility_pack/parse_size.py
index 8b488ca..01ff47d 100644
--- a/utility_pack/parse_size.py
+++ b/utility_pack/parse_size.py
@@ -1,2 +1,19 @@
+_UNITS = {
+    "B": 1,
+    "KB": 1024,
+    "MB": 1024**2,
+    "GB": 1024**3,
+}
+
+
 def parse_size(value: str) -> int:
-    raise NotImplementedError
\ No newline at end of file
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        raise TypeError("size must be a string")
+    text = value.strip()
+    for unit, factor in sorted(_UNITS.items(), key=lambda item: -len(item[0])):
+        if text.upper().endswith(unit):
+            number_part = text[: -len(unit)]
+            if not number_part.isdigit():
+                raise ValueError(f"invalid size: {value!r}")
+            return int(number_part) * factor
+    raise ValueError(f"unknown unit in size: {value!r}")

+++ b/utility_pack/retry_delay.py
@@ -1,2 +1,10 @@
 def retry_delay(attempt: int, base: float = 0.25, cap: float = 8.0) -> float:
-    raise NotImplementedError
\ No newline at end of file
+    if isinstance(attempt, bool) or not isinstance(attempt, int):
+        raise TypeError("attempt must be an integer")
+    if attempt < 0:
+        raise ValueError("attempt must be non-negative")
+    if base <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("base must be positive")
+    if base > cap:
+        raise ValueError("base must not exceed cap")
+    return min(base * (2 ** attempt), cap)
diff --git a/utility_pack/slugify.py b/utility_pack/slugify.py
index 492aaad..85b75b2 100644
--- a/utility_pack/slugify.py
+++ b/utility_pack/slugify.py
@@ -1,2 +1,15 @@
+import unicodedata
+
+
 def slugify(value: str) -> str:
-    raise NotImplementedError
\ No newline at end of file
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        raise TypeError("slugify() expects a string")
+    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", value)
+    text = text.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
+    slug = []
+    for ch in text.lower():
+        if ch.isalnum():
+            slug.append(ch)
+        elif slug and slug[-1] != "-":
+            slug.append("-")
+    return "".join(slug).strip("-")
